subject.title: fix(markdown-core): guard against NaN in ordered list start attribute

question: Should markdown-core normalize malformed token attributes that its built-in markdown-it parsing path does not appear to produce?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the arithmetic failure only after malformed token state exists; deciding whether core should defend against unsupported token mutation requires an explicit ownership choice.

options.title: Require supported-path proof
options.body: Keep the PR open only if the contributor demonstrates a supported token-mutation path and adds a regression test that exercises it.

options.title: Decline unreachable normalization
options.body: Close or withdraw the PR if malformed attributes cannot enter through a supported markdown-core API, leaving validation with the token producer.

recommendation.title: Require supported-path proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open only if the contributor demonstrates a supported token-mutation path and adds a regression test that exercises it.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing candidate for the shared markdown rendering boundary, although the file-level history trail is incomplete.
